# Fixture baseline for the stale-entry split. Against tests/fixtures/braces
# at default thresholds, exactly one finding is current (params many), and it
# is left undeclared on purpose so the case also fixes the failing exit.
long tests/fixtures/braces/shapes.c::guarded    # under threshold now, function still seen: resolved
long tests/fixtures/braces/shapes.c::vanished   # no such function in a live file: unseen, not an improvement
deep tests/fixtures/braces/no_such.c::gone      # the file is gone, and the code with it: resolved
dup tests/fixtures/braces/a.c|tests/fixtures/braces/b.c   # dup keys name file pairs, not functions: resolved
